business_summary: Daiwa Computer Co., Ltd. engages in the software development and service integration businesses in Japan. The company engages in the construction and operation of information systems, system and software design, development, implementation, and maintenance; and consultation on software development process and improvement, and CMMI implementation. The company provides SaaS-based software services and related system and software consulting, design, development, installation, maintenance, and hardware sales and installation. In addition, it engages in the production, processing, and sales of agricultural products; and production, processing, transportation, and sales of tomatoes. Further, the company offers cloud services, RFID services, and i-Agriculture, an agricultural automation technology. Daiwa Computer Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Takatsuki, Japan.
